The protein pool (visceral and so-
matic) N is catabolized to urea; 
urine urea represents 80% of

estimate of protein intake; thus 
usually used only for PN or  
tube-feeding patients.
UUN is compared with the actual

not appropriate in renal insuffi-

wound leakage, cell losses, or

ically stressed patients.
Total Urinary  
Nitrogen 
(TUN)
Some N is excreted as non-urea N 
(e.g., ammonia and creatinine); 
24-hour TUN reflects total pro-
tein catabolism, accounting for 
all sources of urinary N; as for 
UUN, requires accurate protein 
intake. Used primarily to accu-
rately follow the protein cata-
bolic response during disease 
and response to nutritional  
support.
